links.outcome: Whether clinician review of LLM discharge drafts removed generation errors
links.effect: Clinicians edited 48 of 58 drafts, removing 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions; 0/117 delivered physician-facing discrepancies judged seriously consequential.
links.quote: In exploratory comparisons of source, draft and delivered documents, clinicians edited 48 of 58 drafts, removing 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions.

links.outcome: Reviewer detection of incorrect AI-generated content in drafts
links.effect: Clinicians removed only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions, while removing 18 of 22 unsupported additions.
links.quote: In exploratory comparisons of source, draft and delivered documents, clinicians edited 48 of 58 drafts, removing 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions.

models_evaluated: On-premises open-weight LLM (model name not reported)

links.outcome: AI drafting errors not intercepted by clinician review
links.effect: Review removed 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions, demonstrating incomplete interception of errors.
links.quote: In exploratory comparisons of source, draft and delivered documents, clinicians edited 48 of 58 drafts, removing 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions.

links.effect: Record-concordant understanding at follow-up did not differ between LLM-assisted and conventional documents (difference -0.01).
links.quote: Family documents in the LLM-assisted arm used more common vocabulary, but record-concordant understanding at follow-up, the primary outcome, did not differ (difference −0.01; 95% CI −0.12 to 0.10).
